follow-up time: Until postoperative day 1 for mothers, birth for neonates
cohort: 85 women with gestational diabetes mellitus undergoing cesarean section
finding: Taking low-concentration carbohydrate solution 2 hours before induction of anesthesia for patients with gestational diabetes undergoing elective cesarean section is safe and feasible.
mod_finding: This study investigated the safety and feasibility of a low-concentration carbohydrate solution before scheduled cesarean sections in patients with gestational diabetes.
